Description: Production Mobile Battle Royale Gameplay HUD following PUBG Mobile and BGMI layout conventions.

Children.Name: WBP_SquadStatusPanel
Children.Description: Compact 4-player squad roster (Vikram, Ananya, Kabir, Rohan) with health bars, voice icons, and distance.

Children.Name: WBP_CompassAndMinimap
Children.Description: Dynamic rotating compass (360 degrees, N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW, yellow heading needle, squad dots, gunfire blips).

Children.Name: WBP_Minimap
Children.Description: Compact circular Hyderabad Minimap with safe zone circle, blue zone contraction, player pointer, and tap-to-expand.

Children.Name: WBP_MobileControlsLayout
Children.Description: Ergonomic multi-touch touch layer: Left joystick + sprint lock, right fire button, ADS, jump, crouch, prone, reload, and peeks.

Children.Name: WBP_WeaponSlotAndAmmo
Children.Description: Two sleek PUBG weapon slots (VAJRA-556 30/150, GOLCONDA-300 5/35, fire mode, quick switch).

Children.Name: WBP_PlayerVitals
Children.Description: Health bar (100 HP), Vest bar (Lv2), Helmet bar (Lv3), Boost bar (4 segments).

Children.Name: WBP_DeveloperDebugDrawer
Children.Description: Decoupled developer debug drawer, strictly hidden in normal gameplay matches. Toggled via ~ key or dev toggle.
